audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-2].side and phases[6].side say Skill (even), but content win[0-2]/win[6] and the packet levelChart both say Senna. The page currently argues with itself on who wins levels 1-3 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Senna's Piercing Darkness (Q) out-ranges Starcall, heals her while poking you, and has no cooldown penalty for spam (flat 15s); at 2+ items her stacking range/crit/lifesteal outscale Soraka's heal-per-second. Content whys[0-2] and whys[6] already state this correctly — only the full-layer chart was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[2].side, phases[6].side moved to Senna with matching why/rating; win[N] left untouched since it already agreed.

audit.why: phases[4]/[5] (Level 6, First item) correctly mark the even-out once Wish and Moonstone/Redemption come online — matches spikes[1]/[2] in content.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Last Embrace and Equinox as the matchup-defining cooldowns but gives no actual cooldown number for either, so a player can't time it.
audit.why: Senna's Last Embrace (W) is a flat 11s cooldown all ranks; Soraka's Equinox (E) is 20/19/18/17/16s. Stating the numbers lets the player count down the punish window instead of guessing.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with both real numbers.

edits.after: Piercing Darkness out-ranges Starcall and heals Senna while it pokes you — chip you can't trade back at level 1.

edits.before: W opens the battery: your carry's HP bar is now a shared account.
edits.after: Her Q keeps chipping through minions for free while Last Embrace threatens the root before your battery is open.

edits.before: Equinox threats begin: the silence zone cancels engages mid-cast.
edits.after: Poke-and-heal Q still dominates the trade — Wish isn't up yet to answer it.

edits.before: Late Soraka is the global bank: wish the map, silence the dives, and outlast every ledger.
edits.after: Her stacked range, crit and lifesteal let Senna poke from off-screen and out-heal herself faster than you can top your team.

edits.before: - Senna Last Embrace (Root): matchup-defining — The root spreads to nearby targets — stand off your own minions and carry. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Equinox answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.after: Trading Q for Q against her flat 15s cooldown Piercing Darkness — she resets it faster than your bank refills.
